<p class="skill-reference-meta"><span>Arcantry 1.0.0</span><code>audit-skill-portfolio</code></p>

Inventory installed skills, separate aliases from conflicts, and recommend evidence-backed portfolio actions without changing them.

## When to use

Inventory an installed skill portfolio, distinguish aliases from identity conflicts, and recommend evidence-backed routing or consolidation actions. Use only when explicitly requested and remain read-only.

## Link this skill

```text
arcantry skills link audit-skill-portfolio --scope user
```

The standard destination is `~/.agents/skills`. Codex reads this universal Agent Skills location directly.

### Claude compatibility

```text
arcantry skills link audit-skill-portfolio --scope user --compat claude
```

This keeps the universal link and adds a Claude alias to the same canonical package.

## Examples

### Find overlapping installed skills

**Prompt**

> Use the audit-skill-portfolio skill to inspect my installed skills and identify the strongest consolidation candidates.

**Expected outcome**

A read-only inventory that separates deterministic evidence from heuristic overlap and prioritizes a short decision list.

### Audit one repository catalog

**Prompt**

> Use the audit-skill-portfolio skill for this repository's project skills and check naming, invocation policy, and trigger collisions.

**Expected outcome**

A scoped catalog report with diagnostics and tier candidates, without installing, deleting, or rewriting skills.
